notes: Example configuration generated by the CraneCalc configurator; fictitious crane, supplier, site and owner data, to be replaced with project data. Scope: 2 continuous 22.5-ft bays, W21X101 girders, one 12.5-ton pendant crane, on new freestanding W14X283 columns with welded twin-rib bracket seats, base plates, anchor rods and spread footings, and crane-level rod X-bracing; the existing building carries no crane load. Seismic: ordinary steel cantilever column system across the runway and rod bracing not specifically detailed for seismic resistance along it, Seismic Design Category B. Bumper overhang assumed 20 in (end-wheel centerline to the extended bumper face, a typical supplier proportion): the stop contact positions use it; confirm with the crane supplier.

selections.reason: Lightest compact W within the sizing targets (ratio ≤ 0.85, deflections ≤ 0.9 of the limits): H1 top-flange interaction with the load-height LTB strength ratio 0.73, vertical deflection 0.29 and lateral 0.14 of their limits; flanges at least 10.5 in wide for the end bearing bolt gauge and the rail seat; lighter candidates rejected: 59 by flange width, 8 by sizing ratio; the next lighter, W16X100: flange 10.40 in narrower than the 10.50 in the details need. Configurator sizing ratios; the full calculation checks the section.

New cantilever column for a 12.5-ton crane (W14X120 to 5 t, W14X159 to 12.5 t, W14X211 to 25 t, else W14X257). The W14X159 chosen for the crane gives base drift ratio 1.69 > 0.9: the lightest heavier W14 within the drift and torsion ratios.
Set by the tie sizing: the column face moves out from 20 in (to at most 30 in) until the tie passes its imposed-movement and strength checks.

fabrication.steel: Girder ASTM A992; plates, bars and stiffeners ASTM A572 Grade 50 unless noted.
fabrication.bolting: ASTM F3125 Grade A325, pretensioned, Class B faying surfaces, standard holes unless slots are detailed. Sliding-end bearing bolts and column-end tie bolts pretensioned against steel sleeves. Rail joints tight (gap 1/16 in max.) with the rail supplier's joint bars and bolts (deferred submittal), bolts pretensioned and re-tightened after 30 and 90 days of operation.
fabrication.welding: E70XX low-hydrogen electrodes per AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2020, cyclically loaded provisions. Continuous fillets as dimensioned; no intermittent welds on cyclic load paths. Smooth starts and stops.
fabrication.inspection: Visual inspection of all welds; AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2020 cyclically loaded acceptance criteria; magnetic particle testing of fillets at fatigue-sensitive attachments; 100% ultrasonic testing of CJP welds; bolt pretension verification per RCSC.
fabrication.erection: Set and level the bearings, install the end bearings and flange ties, then set the rails. Provide temporary restraint until the permanent ties are complete.
fabrication.railAlignment: Set the rails to the specified gauge, alignment and level tolerances and survey them after erection, before the load test.
